headline: Labor sector proposes 15% increase in minimum wage; asks to eliminate the MIR
summary: A labor sector position paper proposes a 15% increase in the minimum wage and the elimination of the MIR. It argues the current model risks compressing incomes at the base of the labor pyramid.
why: Minimum wage policy in Mexico affects labor costs for employers and household incomes, which feed into consumption and inflation.
original_headline: Sector obrero propone alza de 15% al salario mínimo; piden eliminar el MIR
